tools.name: start-sms-verification
tools.description: Start new phone number verification requests. If the request is successful, you should ask the user to enter the OTP they received on the phone number we are verifying.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in E.164 format to send the SMS to

tools.name: report-sms-verification
tools.description: Report the received verification code to verify it, using the phone number of the user

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in E.164 format used to start the verification process

oneTimePassword.description: The code which was received by the user submitting the SMS verification.

tools.name: number-lookup
tools.description: With quick and easy access to Number Lookup, you can enhance your communications and keep your database as clean as a whistle. Number Lookup checks against first-party numbering sources and provides real-time feedback. Test numbers to ensure your recipients are ready and waiting to receive your messages!

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in E.164 format to look up

tools.name: send-text-message
tools.description: Send a text message to a contact on the specified channel. The contact can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel.

recipient.description: (Required) The recipient to send the message to. This can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel such as Messenger.

channel.description: (Required) The channel to use for sending the message.

appId.description: (Optional) The ID of the app to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "CONVERSATION_APP_ID".

sender.description: (Optional) The phone number of the message's sender (E.164 format). If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "DEFAULT_SMS_ORIGINATOR".

region.description: (Optional) The region to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable CONVERSATION_REGION.

tools.name: send-media-message
tools.description: Send a media message from URL given in parameter to a contact on the specified channel. The contact can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel. The media must be specified with its URL.

recipient.description: (Required) The recipient to send the message to. This can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel such as Messenger.

url.description: The URL of the media that will be the content of the message.

channel.description: (Required) The channel to use for sending the message.

appId.description: (Optional) The ID of the app to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "CONVERSATION_APP_ID".

sender.description: (Optional) The phone number of the message's sender (E.164 format). If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "DEFAULT_SMS_ORIGINATOR".

region.description: (Optional) The region to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable CONVERSATION_REGION.

tools.name: send-location-message
tools.description: Send a location message from an address given in parameter to a contact on the specified channel. The contact can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel.

recipient.description: (Required) The recipient to send the message to. This can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel such as Messenger.

address.description: It can either be the plain text address that will be converted into latitude /longitude or directly the latitude / longitude coordinates if the user wants to send a specific location.

channel.description: (Required) The channel to use for sending the message.

appId.description: (Optional) The ID of the app to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "CONVERSATION_APP_ID".

sender.description: (Optional) The phone number of the message's sender (E.164 format). If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "DEFAULT_SMS_ORIGINATOR".

region.description: (Optional) The region to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable CONVERSATION_REGION.

tools.name: send-choice-message
tools.description: Send a choice message to the user. The choice message can contain up to 3 choices if not text or up to 10 message if text only. Each choice can be a call message (phone number + title to display next to it), a location message (latitude / longitude + title to display next to it), a text message or a URL message (the URL to click on + title to display next to it). The contact can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel.

recipient.description: (Required) The recipient to send the message to. This can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel such as Messenger.

items.description: Choice message that can be a call, location, text, or URL. Exactly one must be provided. The "title" parameter must not be provided is case of text choice.

choiceContent.description: The list of choices to send to the user

text.description: The text to be sent along the choice array

mediaUrl.description: The media URL to be sent along the choice array

channel.description: (Required) The channel to use for sending the message.

appId.description: (Optional) The ID of the app to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "CONVERSATION_APP_ID".

sender.description: (Optional) The phone number of the message's sender (E.164 format). If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "DEFAULT_SMS_ORIGINATOR".

region.description: (Optional) The region to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable CONVERSATION_REGION.

tools.name: send-template-message
tools.description: Send a template message to a contact on the specified channel. The contact can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel.

recipient.description: (Required) The recipient to send the message to. This can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel such as Messenger.

templateId.description: The ID (ULID format) of the omni-template template to use for sending the message.

language.description: The language to use for the omni-template (BCP-47). If not set, the default language code will be used.

parameters.description: The parameters to use for the template. This is a key-value map where the key is the parameter name and the value is the parameter value. Look carefully in the prompt to find which parameters are expected by the template.

channel.description: (Required) The channel to use for sending the message.

appId.description: (Optional) The ID of the app to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "CONVERSATION_APP_ID".

sender.description: (Optional) The phone number of the message's sender (E.164 format). If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "DEFAULT_SMS_ORIGINATOR".

region.description: (Optional) The region to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable CONVERSATION_REGION.

tools.name: send-whatsapp-template-message
tools.description: Send a template message to a contact (phone number in E.164 format) on the WhatsApp channel.

recipient.description: (Required) The recipient to send the message to. This can be a phone number in E.164 format, or the identifier for the specified channel such as Messenger.

templateName.description: The name of the template to use for sending the message on WhatsApp specifically.

templateLanguage.description: The language to use for the WhatsApp template (BCP-47).

parameters.description: The parameters to use for the template. This is a key-value map where the key is the parameter name and the value is the parameter value. Look carefully in the prompt to find which parameters are expected by the template.

appId.description: (Optional) The ID of the app to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "CONVERSATION_APP_ID".

sender.description: (Optional) The phone number of the message's sender (E.164 format). If set, it will override the value from the environment variable "DEFAULT_SMS_ORIGINATOR".

region.description: (Optional) The region to use for the Sinch conversation API. If set, it will override the value from the environment variable CONVERSATION_REGION.

metadata.description: Custom data to send along with the message (e.g. correlation IDs, appointment IDs, etc.)

tools.name: list-conversation-apps
tools.description: Get a list of all Conversation apps in the account. Apps are created and configured in the Sinch Dashboard or with the Conversation API. The App is the entity that holds the credentials related to the various channels

tools.name: list-messaging-templates
tools.description: Get a list of all messaging-related templates (omni-channel or channel specific) belonging to an account. Note that the Email templates are NOT included in this list - they can be found with another tool: list-email-templates. Do not try to use this tool to list Email templates, it will not work.

tools.name: tts-callout
tools.description: Make a callout with a Text-To-Speech prompt

message.description: The message to read out loud

tools.name: get-call-information
tools.description: Get information about a call using its ID

callId.description: The call ID to get information about

tools.name: conference-callout
tools.description: Call a phone number and connects it to a conference room when answered

phoneNumbers.description: The phone numbers to call and connect to the conference room

conferenceId.description: The conference room ID. If not provided, a new one will be generated.

tools.name: manage-conference-participant
tools.description: Manage a conference participant. The conference is identified by the conference Id used in the callout, and the participants by the callId associated to their phone number when the conference callout to their number was made

conferenceId.description: The conference ID used in the callout to create the conference

participantId.description: The participant ID, which is the call ID from the conference callout

action.description: The action to perform on the participant

tools.name: close-conference
tools.description: Close a conference callout

tools.name: send-email
tools.description: Send an email to a recipient with a subject and body.

body.description: The body of the email. Can be text or HTML

template.description: The name of a template to use to render the email body. If provided, the body will be ignored.

templateVariables.description: Variables to use in the template.

domain.description: The domain to use for sending the email. It would override the domain provided in the environment variables.

tools.name: retrieve-email-info
tools.description: Retrieve the content of an email and the events that happened thanks to its ID

domain.description: The domain to use for retrieving the email. If defined, it will override the domain provided in the environment variable "MAILGUN_DOMAIN".

tools.name: list-email-templates
tools.description: Get a list of Email templates from Mailgun for a specific domain. Note that the Messaging templates (omni-channel or channel-specific such as WhatsApp) are NOT included in this list - they can be found with another tool: list-messaging-templates. Do not try to use this tool to list Messaging templates, it will not work.

domain.description: The domain to use for sending the email. It would override the domain provided in the environment variables.

tools.name: list-email-events
tools.description: Get a list of email events from Mailgun for a specific domain. You can filter by event type and limit the number of results.

domain.description: (Optional) The Mailgun domain to fetch events for.

event.description: (Optional) Filter by event type (e.g., delivered, opened, failed).

beginSearchPeriod.description: (Optional) The beginning of the search time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z).

endSearchPeriod.description: (Optional) The end of the search time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: analytics-metrics
tools.description: Get email analytics metrics from Mailgun for an account. All parameters are optional. You can filter by domain, metrics type and specify a time range. By default, it will return all metrics for all your domains for the last 7 days.

domain.description: (Optional) The Mailgun domain to fetch metrics for.

metrics.description: (Optional) The specific metrics to receive the stats for. If not provided, all metrics will be returned.

beginSearchPeriod.description: (Optional) The beginning of the search time range in RFC-2822 format (e.g., Mon, 02 Jun 2025 00:00:00 +0100).

endSearchPeriod.description: (Optional) The end of the search time range in RFC-2822 format (e.g., Mon, 09 Jun 2025 00:00:00 +0100).

tools.name: list-available-regions
tools.description: Lists all regions for numbers provided for the project ID.

types.description: Only return regions for which numbers are provided with the given types: MOBILE, LOCAL or TOLL_FREE.

tools.name: list-rented-numbers
tools.description: Lists all active numbers for a project.

regionCode.description: Region code to filter by. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the phone number. Example: US, GB or SE.

type.description: Number type to filter by. Options include, MOBILE, LOCAL or TOLL_FREE.

searchPattern.description: Sequence of digits to search for. If you prefer or need certain digits in sequential order, you can enter the sequence of numbers here. For example, `2020`.

patternPosition.description: Position of the search pattern. Options include START, END or CONTAINS. If you want the search pattern to be at the beginning of the phone number, select START. If you want it at the end, select END. If you want it to be anywhere in the phone number, select CONTAINS.

capability.description: Number capabilities to filter by SMS and/or VOICE.

size.description: Maximum number of phone numbers to return.

tools.name: rent-sinch-virtual-numbers
tools.description: Activates a phone number that matches the search criteria provided in the request. Currently the rentAny operation works only for US LOCAL numbers

numbers.description: Array of phone numbers to rent. Each number should be in E.164 format with leading `+`

tools.name: search-for-available-numbers
tools.description: Search for available phone numbers that are available for you to activate. You can filter by any property on the available number resource.

regionCode.description: Region code to filter by. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the phone number. Example: US, GB or SE.

type.description: Number type to filter by. Options include, MOBILE, LOCAL or TOLL_FREE.

searchPattern.description: Sequence of digits to search for. If you prefer or need certain digits in sequential order, you can enter the sequence of numbers here. For example, `2020`.

patternPosition.description: Position of the search pattern. Options include START, END or CONTAINS. If you want the search pattern to be at the beginning of the phone number, select START. If you want it at the end, select END. If you want it to be anywhere in the phone number, select CONTAINS.

capabilities.description: Number capabilities to filter by SMS and/or VOICE.

size.description: Maximum number of phone numbers to return.
